messages.author: fee7d8264533fcfd
messages.subject: mapqtl file format for r/qtl
parts:
Hi Karl,

I am writing to you for a data import issue in r/qtl. I used my own and demo data from mapqtl and it showed me the same error. I attached the demo data in the email.

Below is the error using demo data from mapqtl.

hyrb <- read.cross("mapqtl", dir = "MapQTL5", genfile = "DemoCP1.loc", mapfile = "DemoCP1.map", phefile = "DemoCP1.qua")

Error in read.cross.mq.loc(locfile) : 
  nloc=12 but genotypes are found at 60 markers

Can you take a look for me?

Thanks.
Xingbo

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: mapqtl file format for r/qtl
parts:
With the mapqtl format, I think R/qtl requires that the genotypes for a marker (in the .loc file) be all on one line, rather than split over multiple lines. This is likely the cause of the error you are seeing.

karl
